agent.plan: Physical change pehchaan; chemical change ke sanket; rozmarra ke badlav classify; pighalna aur ghulna alag karein

turns.text: kyunki... usmein naya substance nahi banta na? matlab kaagaz phaadne ke baad bhi woh kaagaz hi hai, bas chhote tukdon mein. jaise mera bhai ne kal meri drawing phaad di, woh drawing ka paper hi tha, sirf tukde tukde ho gaye the. toh woh physical hai. lekin ek baar maine school mein paper jalaya tha science lab mein, woh chemical tha na? kyunki woh ash ban gaya, wapas paper nahi bana sakte. dikhao

Aapki drawing phatne wali baat samajh aayi. Kagaz jalne par raakh banti hai; dono badlav ka farq board par likh rahi hoon. Ab cricket poster ko strips mein kaatna aur sparkler jalana sochiye: dono wapas pehle jaise nahi bante, phir chemical badlav kaunsa hai aur kyon?

sparkler jalana chemical change hai, kyunki usmein se roshni aur chingaariyan nikalti hain, aur woh jal ke raakh ban jaata hai, toh naya substance banta hai. poster kaatna toh sirf shape change hai na, physical. reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot yeh hai ki naya substance bane ya nahi. ek baar humne Diwali pe sparkler jalaya tha, itni bright light thi, aur baad mein woh kaali si raakh ban gayi

Aapne Diwali wali sparkler mein roshni aur jalne ke baad kaala bacha hua hissa dekha; poster mein sirf shape badli. Ab ek aur case sochiye: garmi mein bahar rakha doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh ye physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur aapka saboot kya hoga?

chemical change hai na, kyunki doodh khatta ho gaya, uski smell bhi badal gayi, aur woh fat gaya toh naya substance ban gaya - matlab paneer jaisa kuch. waise mummy kehti hain ki phate doodh ki kadhi ban jaati hai, lekin woh phir bhi doodh wapas nahi ho sakta. ek baar humari chhuttiyon pe doodh phat gaya tha aur itni bad smell aa rahi thi, maine toh naak pakad li thi

Haan, phate doodh ki badli hui smell kaafi noticeable hoti hai! Aapne smell aur doodh ka phatna, dono par dhyan diya. Ab Kunal kehta hai ki paani mein namak pighal gaya; usse kaunsa shabd kehna chahiye, aur ye pighalne se kaise alag hai?

arey haan, mummy ne sikhaya tha... dissolve! namak dissolve hota hai paani mein, pighalta nahi. pighalna toh solid se liquid hota hai jaise ghee, bina kisi aur cheez ke. lekin namak toh paani mein chhup jaata hai na, gayab ho jaata hai, dikhta nahi lekin hota zaroor hai. waise mummy ne kal hi chai mein cheeni daali thi, woh bhi dissolve ho gayi, dikhi nahi par chai meethi thi. lekin ek toh yeh whi

Namak paani mein ghulta hai; ghee bina paani ke pighalta hai. Aapki meethi chai se bhi pata chalta hai ki cheeni dikhti nahi, par wahin hai. Taraazu par pehle paani ka glass rakhein, phir usmein do chammach cheeni ghol dein: wazan badhega, utna hi rahega, ya ghatega, aur kyon?

wazan badhega na... kyunki cheeni daali hai toh woh gayab thodi ho gayi, andar hi hai. jaise chai meethi thi, waise hi glass ka wazan bhi badhna chahiye. lekin ruko... mummy kehti hai dissolve mein wazan badhta hai? ya utna hi rehta hai? mujhe lagta hai badhega. ek baar humne class mein kuch aisa kiya tha, shayad wazan nahi badhta tha? pata nahi, badhega bolti hoon
Aapko cheeni glass mein rehne ka idea hai, bas wazan par doubt ho raha hai. Chhota step lete hain: cheeni dikhna band hone ke baad kya woh glass ke andar hi hoti hai?

haan haan, andar hi hogi na... kyunki chai meethi thi toh cheeni toh gayab nahi hui. toh wazan badhega, kyunki paani mein cheeni mil gayi... lekin wait, mummy ne kal rasoi mein kuch bola tha ki bartan ke upar se kuch toh... nahi, badhega hi. waise number line pe yeh dikhao zara, paani aur cheeni ka weight?
Ek misaal ke liye 100, 110 aur 120 gram ke nishaan laga rahi hoon. Agar glass aur paani 100 gram ho aur 10 gram cheeni daalein, toh nishaan kis taraf khiskega?
toh 100 gram glass aur paani hai, phir 10 gram cheeni daal di… toh wazan 110 gram ho jana chahiye na? matlab nishaan 110 ki taraf khiske-ga

Haan, aapke example mein 100 gram mein 10 gram cheeni jodne par nishaan 110 ki taraf khiskega. Ab do drinks sochiye: ek mein room-temperature paani mein cheeni milayi, doosre mein chocolate garam karke liquid banayi. Kis mein ghulna hua, kis mein pighalna, aur kaise pata chala?

cheeni ghulna hai room-temperature paani mein, toh woh dissolving hua. chocolate toh garam karke liquid banayi, uska sirf pighalna hai, kyunki usmein kuch aur mix nahi kiya. aur haan, cheeni ab bhi maujood hai, dikhti nahi lekin paani meetha ho gaya hoga. chocolate ka ek photo dikhao, woh melted wala

Aapne cheeni ka ghulna aur chocolate ka pighalna alag pehchana; cheeni paani mein rehti hai. Melted chocolate ki photo banne mein thoda waqt lagega. Tab tak sochiye: garam chocolate chamach se tapakne lage, toh kya chocolate mein koi nayi cheez bani?

nahi, chocolate toh wahi hai na... sirf shape change hui, solid se liquid. koi naya substance nahi bana. jaise mummy ghee garam karti hai, woh bhi toh pighal ke liquid ho jata hai, par ghee hi rehta hai. ab chocolate ki photo dikhao na pleeeeease

Haan, chocolate garam hone par liquid banti hai, par chocolate hi rehti hai; ghee bhi aise hi pighalta hai. Melted chocolate ki photo banwa rahi hoon, ismein thoda waqt lagega. Tab tak ek aur cheez sochiye: aluminium sheet ko dabaakar lunchbox ka dhakkan banayein, bina kuch milaye, toh yeh physical change hai ya chemical?

physical change hai! kyunki sirf shape change ho rahi hai na, aluminium ko bas dabaya jaa raha hai, naya substance nahi ban raha. jaise mera poster cut karna tha, waise hi yeh bhi. lekin ruko... aluminium sheet ko dabane se uski... kya kehte hain, properties? woh badalti hain kya? nahi, physical hi hoga. par ek baar maine ek cartoon mein dekha tha ki metal ko heat karne se woh strong ban jaata hai

Aapka point hai ki dabane se aluminium ka shape badalta hai, aur aap pooch rahi hain ki properties bhi badalti hain kya. Shape badal sakta hai bina naya substance bane; metal ko heat karne se strength badalna alag baat hai, isliye sirf strength se chemical change decide nahi karte. Baarish ke baad iron railing par laal-bhoori parat bane, jiske gun iron se alag hon, toh yeh physical change hoga ya chemical change?

chemical change hai! kyunki laal-bhoori parat naya substance hai na, aur teacher ne kaha uske gun iron se alag hain. jaise mere ghar ke gate par bhi aisa ho gaya tha, mummy ne kaha woh rust hai aur iron kharab ho gaya. lekin ek baar papa ne usse sandpaper se saaf kiya tha, toh... ruko, agar saaf ho gaya toh wapas aa gaya? toh kya woh reversible ho gaya?

Aapka sawaal sahi jagah par hai: sandpaper se parat hat sakti hai, par usse bani rust wapas iron nahi ban jaati. Jaise phata kaagaz chipka sakte hain, lekin phatne se koi naya substance nahi banta; isliye sirf ‘wapas kar sakte hain?’ se faisla nahi hota. Tyohaar ki mithai banate waqt kitchen mein ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kya ho sakta hai?

physical badlav... mithai banate waqt kya hota hai? haan, mummy ghee garam karti hai na, woh pighalta hai, solid se liquid. yeh physical change hoga kyunki ghee wahi rehta hai bas shape badal gaya. aur chemical badlav... shayad mithai ka colour brown hota hai jab woh cook hoti hai? jaise chashni mein kuch reaction hota hai kya? pata nahi, ek baar mummy ne kuch jala diya tha... oh, chal raha hai, c

Aapne ghee pighalne ka example diya: ghee wahi rehta hai, bas solid se liquid hota hai. Mithai ka brown hona aapko chemical badlav lag raha hai, par sirf rang dekhkar pakka nahi keh sakte. Aapki baat aakhir mein kat gayi thi; chemical badlav ke baare mein aap kya keh rahi thi?
